info.title: ROAST/TTY API
info.description:
ROAST/TTY 终端咖啡馆的后端接口。这是演示站，不是真的商店：不接支付，下单即完成。

- 金额一律是整数元，全部由服务端计算；TUI 只负责显示。
- 除 `/v1/health` 外，后端设置了 COFFEE_INTERNAL_KEY 时每个请求都要带 `X-Internal-Key`。
- 会员会话：`Authorization: Bearer <token>`（注册、登录、恢复登录时得到）。
- `X-SSH-Fingerprint`：本次 SSH 连接的公钥指纹，用于“记住我”；`X-Client-IP`：客户端 IP，仅用于限流。
- 日期：`*At` 是 UTC 时刻（ISO 8601）；`*Date` / `*On` 是店铺时区（Asia/Shanghai）的日历日期。
- 错误一律是 `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`，`message` 与 code 一一对应：

| code | HTTP | message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bad_request` | 400 | 请求格式错误 |
| `validation_failed` | 400 | 请求参数不合法 |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | 缺少或错误的内部密钥 |
| `not_found` | 404 | 资源不存在 |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | 不支持该请求方法 |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | 操作太频繁，请稍后再试 |
| `internal_error` | 500 | 服务器内部错误 |
| `not_implemented` | 501 | 功能尚未实现 |
| `login_required` | 401 | 请先登录 |
| `session_expired` | 401 | 登录已失效 |
| `username_required` | 422 | 请输入用户名 |
| `username_invalid` | 422 | 用户名需为 2–16 个字符，可用中文、字母、数字和下划线 |
| `password_too_short` | 422 | 密码至少 6 位 |
| `password_too_long` | 422 | 密码最多 128 位 |
| `username_taken` | 409 | 这个用户名已被注册 |
| `invalid_credentials` | 401 | 用户名或密码不正确 |
| `fingerprint_required` | 400 | 当前连接没有 SSH 公钥，无法记住登录 |
| `not_remembered` | 404 | 当前公钥没有记住的登录 |
| `quantity_invalid` | 422 | 数量应为 1–9 |
| `sold_out` | 409 | 该重量暂时缺货 |
| `out_of_stock` | 409 | 库存不足 |
| `cart_full` | 409 | 购物车最多放 50 种规格 |
| `coupon_invalid` | 422 | 优惠码无效或已过期 |
| `empty_selection` | 409 | 还没有勾选商品 |
| `address_required` | 409 | 请先选择收货地址 |
| `price_changed` | 409 | 价格有变化，请确认后再结算 |
| `recipient_required` | 422 | 请填写收货人 |
| `region_required` | 422 | 请填写所在地区 |
| `detail_required` | 422 | 请填写详细地址 |
| `phone_invalid` | 422 | 手机号应为 11 位数字 |
| `text_too_long` | 422 | 内容太长了 |
| `address_limit` | 409 | 地址最多保存 20 条 |

post.summary: 注册（用户名 + 密码）并登录
post.description: Creates the user (password hashed with argon2id), its empty cart and default settings, then a session, as login does. With `remember` and `X-SSH-Fingerprint`, binds the key to the new user for 30 days (replacing any binding of that key). Rate limit: see `docs/design/decisions.md` (P-auth-3).

parameters.description: 本次 SSH 连接的公钥指纹（`SHA256:…`），由 TUI 从会话环境转发；只在带内部密钥的请求里可信。

post.summary: 登录（用户名 + 密码），可选记住当前 SSH 公钥 30 天
post.description: Username matching ignores the case of ASCII letters. A wrong username and a wrong password are the same `invalid_credentials`. With `remember` and `X-SSH-Fingerprint`, (re)binds the key to this user for 30 days from now; without `remember` an existing binding is left alone. The guest cart is merged afterwards by `POST /v1/cart/merge`.

post.summary: 访客购物车报价：为客户端持有的购物车计价
post.description: Prices the lines as the member cart would, in the given order; lines of the same SKU are summed (capped at 9). Unknown products are `not_found`; sold-out weights and quantities above stock are priced and flagged in `problem`. An invalid non-empty coupon is `coupon_invalid` (re-quote without it). `address` is always `null`. Nothing is stored.

post.summary: 登录后把访客购物车合并进会员购物车
post.description: In guest order, each line is added like `addCartLine` but never fails: quantities are capped at min(9, stock); unknown products, sold-out weights, products without stock and lines beyond 50 are skipped (`skippedCount`). A new line keeps the guest `selected` flag; a line merged into an existing one is selected if either was. A valid `couponCode` replaces the member coupon; an invalid one is ignored.

post.summary: 结算下单（演示：不扣款，下单即完成）
post.description: One transaction: take the selected lines (none: `empty_selection`) and the order address (none: `address_required`); re-price them (`services/pricing.ts`) with the cart coupon; check each weight (`sold_out`) and that each product has stock for the sum of its lines (`out_of_stock`, details); compare `expectedTotal` (`price_changed`); decrement stock; create the order with a unique number (retry on collision), name/price/address snapshots and ETA = now + 3 days; delete the purchased lines and clear the coupon. On any error nothing changes.
